name: model-canary
description: Detect agent behavior changes when the model/provider changes and the app code does not.

scripts.demo:drift: rm -f history/demo.jsonl && for i in 1 2 3; do HISTORY=history/demo.jsonl MODEL=sim-v1 tsx src/canary.ts || exit 1; done; HISTORY=history/demo.jsonl MODEL=sim-v2 tsx src/canary.ts; echo "exit code: $? (1 = drift detected)"
